function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力（電荷的運動與靜電現象）並非由單一人物「發現」的，而是經過多位科學家在不同時期逐步揭示的。以下是幾個關鍵人物與里程碑：

| 時期 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 古希臘 | 泰勒斯（Thales of Miletus） | 觀察到摩擦後的靜電現象，將其稱為「電」(elektron)。 |
| 17 世紀 | 威廉·吉爾伯特（William Gilbert） | 在《De Magnete》一書中首次將電與磁區分，提出「電磁學」概念。 |
| 18 世紀 | 本傑明·富蘭克林（Benjamin Franklin） | 進行閃電與電荷的實驗，提出正負電荷概念，並發明避雷針。 |
| 19 世紀 | 亞歷山大·伏打（Alessandro Volta） | 發明伏打電池，證明電流可以由化學反應產生。 |
| 19 世紀 | 何塞·馬克斯韋（Julius Maxwell） | 整合電磁學方程式，預測電磁波的存在。 |
| 19 世紀 | 赫爾曼·赫茲（Heinrich Hertz） | 實驗證實電磁波的存在，為無線電技術奠定基礎。 |

簡而言之，電力的「發現」是一個漸進的歷史過程，從古代對靜電的觀察，到近代對電流、電磁學的系統研究，最終形成了今天我們所熟知的電力科學與技術。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can answer: Electricity was discovered by many scientists over centuries. The earliest known observations by Thales of Miletus, then William Gilbert, then Benjamin Franklin, etc. But the question might be ambiguous: "who discovered electricity?" We can give a concise answer: The phenomenon of static electricity was observed by ancient Greeks; the term "electricity" comes from Greek "elektron" meaning amber. The first systematic study was by William Gilbert in 1600s. Benjamin Franklin's experiments in 1750s. But the discovery of electricity as a phenomenon is not credited to a single person. So answer accordingly.
